subject: finnish
summary: Finnish comprehension cards look good: clear one-sentence questions, the right article attached and legible, and a short model answer with a mark badge. The two essay cards are the problem. One shows 'The scheme prints no answer for this part' with a 0-40 button grid; the other buries the useful content (a description of a good essay and about fifteen suggested ideas) in a 30-line block of small grey text made of quoted fragments joined by semicolons, inside the first tick box. One comprehension card's scheme is three paragraphs copied word for word from the reading text, still carrying their paragraph numbers (4), (5), (6), so it reads as the source rather than an answer. The grey language-rule note appears in every scheme.

issues.title: Essay guidance flattened into a grey wall of quoted fragments
issues.detail: Card 5's first tick box starts with about 30 lines (phone) of small grey text: the language rule, then 'Under the two titles the scheme prints “...”. Under “HUOMAA: ...” it prints the four criteria with no marks or percentages beside them, so they are shown and the part is scored on its printed total. Under the scheme's heading “Hyvän vastauksen aineksia:”, as examples, not a checklist: “yhteisöllisyys on tärkeää”; “nykyään yksilöllisyys on korostuneesti esillä”; ...' and so on for fifteen quoted ideas joined by semicolons. The real content is there but unreadable, and criterion 1 is tacked on underneath it in the same box.
issues.suggested_fix: Three plain blocks: 'What a good essay looks like' (the one-sentence description), 'Ideas you could use' (bulleted list), and the four criteria as their own rows. No commentary about what the scheme prints.

issues.title: 'Scheme prints no answer' essay card
issues.detail: Card 3 shows 'The scheme prints no answer for this part.', a grey paragraph ('it prints no answer, no content and no criteria for this part') and 41 number buttons under the heading 'Select the points you actually got'. Card 5 from the previous year shows criteria exist for this task type.
issues.suggested_fix: Reuse the four essay criteria and a banded self-grade; change the heading.

issues.title: Scheme is the reading text copied verbatim
issues.detail: Card 4's three scheme points are paragraphs (4), (5) and (6) of the article word for word, including the bracketed paragraph numbers, in first person. It does not read as an answer to 'Why does the writer say he has no job?' and the '(4)', '(5)', '(6)' look like stray numbering. No marks per point.
issues.suggested_fix: Label as 'Relevant paragraphs of the text (4-6)' or summarise each into the idea expected; drop the bare numbers or write 'Par. 4:'.

issues.title: Grey language-rule note in every scheme
issues.detail: 'The examination requires every answer in FINNISH. The paper prints the rule on page 2: "Ohje: Vastaa kaikkiin tehtäviin suomeksi."' sits under or above each answer.

issues.title: Essay title not set off; 'choose one of these' with one title
issues.detail: Cards 3 and 5 read 'Kirjoita suunnilleen 300 sanan aine. Valitse aiheeksi toinen näistä: Kukaan ei ole saari' as one run of text; the title has no quotation marks or line of its own, and only one of the two titles is shown.
issues.suggested_fix: Title on its own line in bold; drop 'choose one of these'.

issues.title: Model answer in one all-or-nothing box
issues.detail: Cards 1 and 2 give a three-sentence model answer as a single 5m box. Readable, but no partial credit.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into the two or three ideas.

good_examples.why: Clear question, compact model answer, correct article attached.
Same clean pattern; attached text is sharp with the glossed words in bold.
